summary: MARA is a high-dilution but honestly-disclosed small-cap distressed name. The forensic-disclosure framework finds NO material lying: hash-rate progression reconciles across three filings; counterparty mirror with APLD verifies the Garden City acquisition bilaterally; insider Form 4 register shows essentially zero personal cashing-out alongside the ~$750M ATM raise (officers being diluted with the public). The 'going concern' trigger from automated screening is a FALSE POSITIVE (boilerplate risk-factor language, NOT auditor-issued substantial doubt); cash+BTC liquidity of $1.56B at Q1'24 is robust, though 79% is BTC-correlated with the share price. Honesty-alpha read: MARA is NOT a liar — the framework's exclusion-of-liars discipline catches that the dilution and operational pressure are fully disclosed. NEUTRAL tier on honesty grounds, with C6 (halving opacity) being the only Mode-B catch that could justify a SHORT-tier lean if combined with separate macro/Bitcoin-price thesis.
